1.4.literalText: S4: restart recovery rebuilds the live host from the journal head and the effective branch; prove with the umbrella's restart pack against a rewound match.
exists: MatchRecovery.recoverActiveMatches ALREADY has a journal/branch-aware path for the REWOUND case: tryFoldActivatedRewindBranch (ServerMatchHostRewindRebuild.ts:118-146) calls branches.readEffectiveHead(stream) (line 130), and if the head names a non-root branch, reads the ACTIVATED branch's events (readActivatedBranchGameEvents) rather than the legacy mp_match_events log, then MatchRecovery.ts:163-178 calls host.adoptServedBranch(rewound.branchId) and host.boundReplayToEffectiveHead(...) so the recovered host serves the activated branch.

ServerMatchHost exposes servedBranchId() / adoptServedBranch() / boundReplayToEffectiveHead() (ServerMatchHost.ts:525-587, 1163) as the plumbing this recovery path (and the live branch admission consult's onLivePath check) both consume.
missing: For the ORDINARY (non-rewound) restart path — the common case — MatchRecovery.ts:194-260 rebuilds ENTIRELY from `store.getEvents(matchId, fromExclusive)` (the legacy mp_match_events log) through checkpointRecoveryPort/referenceRecoveryPort. It never reads readEffectiveHead or consults the journal at all in this branch. So 'restart recovery rebuilds the live host from the journal head' is true only for an already-rewound stream today; the mainline path is exactly the 'legacy event table alone' design.md explicitly says S4 must stop being.

No catch-up / divergence-detection exists between the legacy log and the journal mirror at boot. S1's own non-claims say explicitly: 'NO catch-up for a mirror that fell behind... closing it is S4/S6 work', and the review's RR-1 (no busy_timeout -> SQLITE_BUSY swallowed into the tripwire -> stream refuses every later mirror with revision-conflict forever) is an ordinary-load failure mode that only S4 (or S6) can close per that review's explicit escalation.

No restart-pack proof exists yet against a match that was mirrored into the journal (mode 'shadow'/'enabled') and then restarted — the only restart proof e2e rows (E2E-05, E2E-06, notepad.md) exercise the pre-journal legacy path; E2E-15 ('restart restores full authority') is itself classified 'missing' in notepad.md with 'active branch explicitly deferred'.

part2_task1_2_amendment.proposedAmendedText: S2: with S1's mirror admitting matches at mode 'shadow'/'enabled', prove that ServerMatchHostBranchAdmission's live branch admission consult and readEffectiveHead become reachable against real journal-backed heads for a live match. Per History B's repair (PR #1674), ONE STALE_BRANCH arm is reachable on the live-activation path — a host still serving an identity (root/baseline or a prior servedBranchId) that the store has since superseded via activation (`!onLivePath`) — answered with the active branch and a resync action. A head naming a non-effective (superseded) branch is a SEPARATE, unreachable-by-construction shape on the live path (the branch-activation transaction cannot leave such a head) and is answered `MATCH_QUARANTINED` (`history-integrity-blocked`) as persisted-corruption, not `STALE_BRANCH`. Prove all four illegal command shapes the umbrella's 14.2-a receipt names, end to end, through a real journal head installed by S1's mirror (not a hand-constructed fixture head).

fourIllegalShapesMappedToRefusals.shape: (1) a player intent whose stream's effective head is not the live-path identity (host still serves root/baseline, or a prior servedBranchId, while the store has activated a replacement candidate)
fourIllegalShapesMappedToRefusals.refusal: STALE_BRANCH — conflictHead = the active head, recoveryAction = resync-to-active-head (EXPECTED_HEAD_RESYNC_ACTION). This is the ONE reachable STALE_BRANCH arm after B's repair (`!onLivePath` in ServerMatchHostBranchAdmission.ts:~190-195).

fourIllegalShapesMappedToRefusals.shape: (2) an intent arriving while the effective branch is superseded (a persisted head literally naming a non-effective/superseded branch)
fourIllegalShapesMappedToRefusals.refusal: AMENDED by B: MATCH_QUARANTINED, reason history-integrity-blocked, no conflictHead, no recoveryAction. Pre-B this was answered STALE_BRANCH; post-B it is unreachable through the live admission consult by construction (readEffectiveHead itself refuses a non-effective branch as branch-integrity, caught and translated to MATCH_QUARANTINED at ServerMatchHostBranchAdmission.ts:163-166). The umbrella's 14.2-a receipt text still says STALE_BRANCH for this shape; that text is stale, per the owner-ruling flag above.

fourIllegalShapesMappedToRefusals.shape: (3) any non-request payload that carries targetRevision (a rewind cut) from a non-host actor
fourIllegalShapesMappedToRefusals.refusal: GM_ONLY, reason gm-role-required (namesRewindCut(...) && actorId !== hostPlayerId branch, ServerMatchHostBranchAdmission.ts:~150-153). The host's own equivalent payload passes admission unchanged.

fourIllegalShapesMappedToRefusals.shape: (4) a player submits a non-mutating RewindRequest (targetRevision + reason)
fourIllegalShapesMappedToRefusals.refusal: accepted-for-gm-review (ACCEPTED_FOR_GM_REVIEW), derives no event — answerAcceptedForGmReview, first branch checked in refuseLiveBranchAdmission (envelope.intent.kind === 'RewindRequest').
